data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'awfa' meaning 'to shine', 'to be bright'. This name is often given to babies born during the time of the new moon or a lunar eclipse. The name Awfar carries the meaning “Bright, Shining” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Awfar usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Naming the child Awfar highlights this connection and emphasizes the importance of the new beginning in their lives.
